lines: 1. Hei kandih hei mu neikhat man puni,
Ban)_3 kasiammei guai hei aman nutuang de;
Tiki lummei guai mu aman tuang nai lak khe,
Ntakmei )_3 kai sumei kum tuang e.
Chorus:
Nangniu Raguang kai e
Nthan liangmei kai e,
Nangniu thai mak na cho?
Bumang thanmei kai e;
Raguang kai sumanmei guai khang,
Raguang )_3 manmei tei tini,
Raguang kai thu than e
Nangniu thai mak na cho?
2. Khrista rukhou suthaomei kaiphun guai mu,
Kachak le lupah Kaman kungmei su puni;
Tiki thingnuang panu )_3 suthaomei guai,
Nkhampui nung maikuam khou lou puni.
3. Khrista rukhou kaiphun suna lungmei guai,
Neilamei la puni panti hei luai pukhou;
Nangtan pankhou )_3na nangsuan latou puni,
Kumma asei kaikhou tei gut puni.
4. Khrista rukhou ram mak kaiphun baimei mak,
Thiammei puanjing )_3 guanga kanuk khuansini;
Khrista rukhou supui jang )_3 kachan lak khe,
Kumma asei kai hei kaikhun di the.
